children: Immunocore announced achievement of target enrollment (540 patients) in the Phase 3 TEBE-AM trial and expects topline overall survival data as early as end of 2026.
Reached target enrollment of 540 patients in global registrational TEBE-AM Phase 3 trial for previously treated, HLA-A*02:01-positive advanced melanoma.
Trial compares tebentafusp monotherapy and tebentafusp plus pembrolizumab versus Investigator’s Choice; primary endpoint is overall survival.
Patients will continue follow-up for planned overall survival analysis; topline OS data expected as early as end of 2026.
Company estimates tebentafusp could address up to ~4,000 HLA-A*02:01-positive previously treated advanced melanoma patients in US and Europe.
